101	async function loadPersonaYaml(yamlPath: string): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
   102	  const raw = await readFile(yamlPath, 'utf8');
   103	  const parsed: unknown = yaml.load(raw);
   104	
   105	  if (parsed === null || parsed === undefined || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) {
   106	    throw new Error(`buildPersona: expected a YAML object in "${yamlPath}"`);
   107	  }

   110

   112	  if (!record['name']) {

   119	/**
   120	 * Resolve the output directory for a given target from a suite configuration.
   121	 *
   122	 * Resolution order (first match wins):
   123	 *   1. `suiteConfig.outputDirs[definition.outputDirKey]` — generic map, takes precedence.
   124	 *   2. `suiteConfig.outVscode` — deprecated fallback for the built-in 'vscode' key.
   125	 *   3. `suiteConfig.outClaudeCode` — deprecated fallback for the built-in 'claude-code' key.
   126	 *
   127	 * The lookup key is `definition.outputDirKey` when a registry definition is
   128	 * provided, falling back to the raw `target` name for unregistered targets
   129	 * (where `outputDirKey` equals the name by convention).
   130	 *
   131	 * @param target      The build target name.
   132	 * @param suiteConfig The suite configuration to resolve from.
   133	 * @param definition  Optional registry definition for the target. When present,
   134	 *                    `definition.outputDirKey` is used as the output dir map key.
   135	 * @returns           Resolved output directory path.
   136	 * @throws {Error}    When no output directory is configured for the target.
   137	 */
   138	function resolveOutputDir(
   139	  target: string,
   140	  suiteConfig: SuiteConfig,
   141	  definition?: TargetDefinition,
   142	): string {
   143	  // Build a merged map: deprecated named fields provide the base, outputDirs overrides.
   144	  const merged: Record<string, string> = {};
   145	  if (suiteConfig.outVscode) merged['vscode'] = suiteConfig.outVscode;
   146	  if (suiteConfig.outClaudeCode) merged['claude-code'] = suiteConfig.outClaudeCode;
   147	  if (suiteConfig.outputDirs) Object.assign(merged, suiteConfig.outputDirs);
   148	
   149	  // Use outputDirKey from the registry definition when available, falling back
   150	  // to the target name for unregistered targets where outputDirKey === name.
   151	  const lookupKey = definition?.outputDirKey ?? target;
   152	  const dir = merged[lookupKey];
   153	  if (dir) return dir;
   154	
   155	  throw new Error(
   156	    `buildPersona: no output directory configured for target "${target}". ` +
   157	      `Add outputDirs['${lookupKey}'] to the suite config, or, for the built-in ` +
   158	      `targets, provide the outVscode / outClaudeCode fields.`,
   159	  );
   160	}
   161	
   162	/**
   163	 * Pre-scan all suites and build a cross-suite agent name map.
   164	 *
   165	 * For each persona across all configured suites, creates a context variable:
   166	 *   key:   `agent_` + slug (hyphens → underscores)
   167	 *   value: `"<name> v<version>"`
   168	 *
   169	 * Slug is taken from the persona YAML's `slug` field, falling back to the
   170	 * filename stem. Version falls back to the suite's `default_version`, then
   171	 * to `'0.0.0'`.
   172	 *
   173	 * @param config  Top-level BuildConfig with all suite definitions
   174	 * @returns       Map of agent variable keys to display strings
   175	 */
   176	async function buildAgentNameMap(
   177	  config: BuildConfig,
   178	): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
   179	  const agentMap: Record<string, string> = {};
   180	
   181	  for (const [, suiteConfig] of Object.entries(config.suites)) {
   182	    const metaSubdir = suiteConfig.metaSubdir ?? 'meta';
   183	    const sharedYamlPath = path.join(suiteConfig.srcDir, metaSubdir, '_shared.yaml');
   184	    const sharedMeta = await loadRawYaml(sharedYamlPath);
   185	    const defaultVersion =
   186	      typeof sharedMeta['default_version'] === 'string'
   187	        ? sharedMeta['default_version']
   188	        : '0.0.0';
   189	
   190	    const personaYamls = await discoverSuitePersonaYamls(suiteConfig);
   191	
   192	    for (const yamlPath of personaYamls) {
   193	      const persona = await loadPersonaYaml(yamlPath);
   194	
   195	      const slug =
   196	        typeof persona['slug'] === 'string'
   197	          ? persona['slug']
   198	          : path.basename(yamlPath, '.yaml');
   199	
   200	      const name =
   201	        typeof persona['name'] === 'string'
   202	          ? persona['name']
   203	          : slug;
   204	
   205	      const version =
   206	        typeof persona['version'] === 'string'
   207	          ? persona['version']
   208	          : defaultVersion;
   209	
   210	      const underscoredSlug = slug.replace(/-/g, '_');
   211	      const key = `agent_${underscoredSlug}`;
   212	      agentMap[key] = `${name} v${version}`;
   213	
   214	      const slugKey = `agent_slug_${underscoredSlug}`;
   215	      agentMap[slugKey] = slug;
   216	    }
   217	  }
   218	
   219	  return agentMap;
   220	}
